upstream.commit_subject: Add Ascend expert-parallel benchmarks and profiling tools

layout: Files keep their upstream paths, so adding this directory to sys.path makes `import ep.<name>.demo` resolve exactly as it does in a full checkout. operators/vendor/.gitattributes marks the tree -text so git stores these bytes verbatim and the digests above stay valid on every platform.

license.note: Upstream publishes no LICENSE, COPYING or NOTICE file at this commit and no copyright or license header in any source file. Do not redistribute this copy until the owner signs off; see operators/vendor/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
